ref_text: BY BEING STUDIOUS OF COLOR THEY ARE STUDIOUS OF DIVISION AND WHILE THE CHIAROSCURIST DEVOTES HIMSELF TO THE REPRESENTATION OF DEGREES OF FORCE IN ONE THING UNSEPARATED LIGHT THE COLORISTS HAVE FOR THEIR FUNCTION THE ATTAINMENT OF BEAUTY BY ARRANGEMENT OF THE DIVISIONS OF LIGHT
text: By being studious of color they are studious of division, and while the Kira-Skirus devotes himself to the representation of degrees of force and one thing, unsapparatated light, the colorists have for their function, the attainment of beauty, by arrangement of the divisions of light.
